column7: Unique room identifier. Primary key for all room-level operations, contracts, and matching.
Foreign key to parent property. Enables property-to-room hierarchy and roll-up reporting.
Drives pricing differential and tenant preference filtering.
Amenity flag. Impacts listing quality and tenant desirability score.
Specific to room. Required for listing accuracy and tenant expectation setting.
High-impact amenity. Directly affects pricing band and tenant filtering.
AC specification for maintenance and listing detail. Only populated when AC = true.
Working space flag. Important for student and WFH tenant segments.
Room-specific walkthrough media. Primary evidence for condition disputes at exit.
Tracks when the annexure was last refreshed. Ensures documentation is current at each tenancy.
Room-level listed rent. Source of truth for pricing. Property-level rent is an aggregate of room rents.
Room-specific maintenance charge. May differ across rooms in a property.
Current operational state. Drives availability display, matching eligibility, and PSM task triggers.
Foreign key to active contract. NULL when room is vacant. Enables fast occupancy lookup.
Display field for quick reference. Avoids join to contract and contact objects.
Earliest date room can be occupied. Drives availability calendar and lead matching.
